newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Rothmans Inds views future with optimism.
newsitem.headline: Rothmans Inds views future with optimism.

text.p: Cigarette company Rothmans Industries Ltd said on Saturday it continued to view the future with optimism.

The company said in a statement with its annual results that and improvement in volumes in the Singapore domestic market was not expected to continue as the benefits of a reduction in smuggling were already accounted for and consumer sales were expected to decline in response to anti-smoking pressures.

"The rapidly changing business conditions in the regional markets make it difficult to predict how they may impact on the business. Efforts to sustain volume growth are expected to meet increasing competitive pressures in the market place," it said.

"However, despite the uncertainties and potential difficulties, management continues to view the future with optimism. The company remains committed to the development of all regional markets by strengthening the distribution of its brands supported by aggressive marketing programmes," it added.
Rothmans Industries is a unit of Rothmans International Plc
